body: `processArray` doesn't say much about the process that is applied to the array. In this case you're shifting the values, what about `shiftItemsValues`?

We should only use `==` when we want JS to make [type coercion](https://code.tutsplus.com/articles/the-beginners-guide-to-type-coercion-a-practical-example--cms-21998) automatically. Since we're comparing numbers, it should not be an issue to use `===`.
It might be a bit confusing to talk about website hierarchy because search is only a part of the website. I would go for something like 'facet hierarchy', WDYT?
